raw_blocks: We offer a variety of services to make your life a little easier
By offering exceptional values on quality merchandise, EZCORP appeals to a growing segment of budget-conscious shoppers. Our sales reflect that.
At EZCORP, we help customers turn their valuables into instant cash. We buy everything from gold and diamonds to electronics, tools, musical instruments and more.
EZCORP provides a variety of quick, convenient and confidential ways to borrow money – helping millions meet their immediate financial needs every year.
We have the right people in the right place at the right time, to lead the way today and to step into greater roles tomorrow.
We simplify our approach to business by focusing on behaviors and actions that drive positive customer and business results.
We actively collaborate as a team, celebrate our wins, communicate our efforts and motivate every Team Member to do their best every day.

Do you enjoy delighting customers and learning something new every day? We invite you to join us for a career – not just a job. At EZCORP, we are looking for Team Members to lead the way today and to step into greater roles tomorrow in a fun and fast-paced environment that comes with competitive pay and generous bonus potential.

Since the day we opened our doors, our goal has been the same: to make our customers' lives easier. Our mission is to put the "reuse" in Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, and do good for the environment by extending the useful life of millions of items and strongly contributing to the circular economy.

In 2022 alone, EZCORP recycled more than 5.6 million pre-loved items across our family of brands. If everyone bought one pre-loved item instead of a new one, we would save our planet from billions of pounds of waste.

raw_blocks: EZCORP provides customers the opportunity to convert merchandise they no longer need into instant cash. We buy quality used items ranging from gold and diamond jewelry to electronics, video games, musical instruments, tools, sporting goods, and more. We pride ourselves on fair and accurate appraisals. Quite simply, we help our customers get more money for their things.

In today’s economy, a growing number of consumers demand value, and EZCORP delivers. We sell an array of quality used items at budget-friendly prices. In fact, our customers save up to 70% off regular retail prices every day. Our selection of merchandise is wide and ever-changing and includes gold, jewelry, electronics, tools, sporting goods, luxury handbags, shoes & sneakers, musical equipment and much more!

Customers rely on EZCORP for loans that are fast, convenient, and confidential. We go above and beyond to encourage responsibility and are guided by the principles of honesty, integrity, and fairness. We provide instant cash loans on items of value, including gold and diamond jewelry, electronics, computers, musical instruments, tools, video games, firearms (US only) and more. EZCORP works closely with every customer to help them get the money they need.
